{{Short description|3D fractal composed of tangential spheres}}
[[Image:Apollonian spheres.jpg|thumb|Apollonian sphere packing]]

'''Apollonian sphere packing''' is the three-dimensional equivalent of the [[Apollonian gasket]]. The principle of construction is very similar: with any four spheres that are [[Tangent|cotangent]] to each other, it is then possible to construct two more spheres that are cotangent to four of them, resulting in an infinite [[sphere packing]].
